jem_advancements.patchouli.name: Just Enough Mods Field Guide
jem_advancements.patchouli.subtitle: A path to complete progression
jem_advancements.patchouli.landing_text: Select a JEM advancement to open its exact field-guide entry.
jem_advancements.patchouli.open_failed: This guide entry could not be opened. Advancement progression is unaffected.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.root.title: Life Just Got Easier!
jem_guide.advancement.qol.root.descripti: Little conveniences can change a big adventure.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Little conveniences make every expedition smoother.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.1.title: ENHANCE!
jem_guide.advancement.qol.1.description: Look at a living creature through a Spyglass.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Take a Spyglass and look at any living creature through it.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.13.title: Do I Have to Fall?
jem_guide.advancement.qol.13_3_1.title: Four of a Kind
jem_guide.advancement.qol.13_3_1.descrip: Collect enough Spirit Orbs for one real choice.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Collect four Spirit Orbs—enough for one upgrade at a Goddess Statue.
At a Goddess Statue, spend four Spirit Orbs on a permanent health increase.
At a Goddess Statue, spend four Spirit Orbs on a permanent stamina increase.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.7.title: What's On Your Back?
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Equip a backpack in its equipment slot. Simply carrying it in your inventory is not enough.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.7_1.title: Never Enough Room
jem_guide.advancement.qol.7_1.descriptio: Spend earned backpack experience on your first useful unlock.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Earn backpack experience and spend it on any first upgrade.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.7_3.title: Another One?!
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Unlock another backpack slot and wear two backpacks at the same time.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.8.title: TIMBEEEER!
jem_guide.advancement.qol.8.description: Fell an entire tree through one shared chopping process.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Chop a tree with TreeChop until the whole tree falls.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.8_3.title: Mushroom? Close Enough.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.8_3.descriptio: Fell a giant mushroom or fungus through TreeChop.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Find a giant mushroom that TreeChop can fell as a whole and bring it down like a tree.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.group_homecomi: Return to your bed together with a friend.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Stand together inside the 3-by-3 formation. The center player must use the Magical Returner so both players arrive at the host's bed.
Group return to the host’s bed
Get a Nature's Compass and keep it in your inventory.
jem_guide.advancement.qol.universal_leas: Leash an entity that normally refuses a lead.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Use a normal Lead on a mob that vanilla Minecraft normally refuses to leash.
jem_guide.advancement.mobs.root.title: They’re Here for a Reason
jem_guide.advancement.mobs.root.descript: Every good creature has a reason to exist.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Learn what the creatures around you can actually do.
jem_guide.advancement.mobs.8_4_1.title: Sweet Dreams
jem_guide.advancement.mobs.8_4_1.descrip: Make a Dreamcatcher using an antler from another part of the pack’s ecosystem.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Craft a Dreamcatcher using a Caribou, Elk or White-Tailed Deer Antler. Other types of antler do not count.
Caribou, Elk and White-Tailed Deer Antlers
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.root.title: More Than Sharp
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.root.descr: Good gear changes more than numbers — it changes your decisions.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Master unusual weapons, clever shots, and heavy machinery.
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.ballista.d: Get your hands on a Ballista.
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.catapult.d: Get your hands on a Catapult.
Obtain any Ruinfighter or Duskfire armor piece.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Obtain any Ruinfighter or Duskfire armor piece.
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.efn_armor_: Collect both complete Ruinfighter and Duskfire armor sets.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Collect the helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots from both the Ruinfighter and Duskfire sets.
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.efn_weapon: Complete the collection of twenty-one obtainable weapons.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Collect one of each of the twenty-one obtainable weapons, from the Ruins Greatsword to Excalibur. Internal states, hidden variants, and test items do not count.
Complete collection of obtainable weapon forms
jem_guide.advancement.arsenal.efn_weapon: Obtain a weapon such as the Ruins Greatsword or Duskfire.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Obtain a collectible weapon such as the Ruins Greatsword, Duskfire or Ancient Sculk Twinblades. Internal weapon-state items are excluded.
Collectible weapons and their base forms
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.root.title: Something’s Biting!
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.root.descr: Cast a line and find out how deep this hobby really goes.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Cast into stranger waters and see what answers.
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.4_3.title: A Rod Caught a Rod
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.4_3.descri: Fish up a rare fishing rod, then catch a fish with the rod you caught.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: In the appropriate conditions, fish up the rare Suncatcher rod as a fishing reward. Then equip that exact rod and successfully catch a fish with it.
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.5_6.title: All That Glitters
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.5_6.descri: Catch the Midas Fish while actually meeting its Luck requirement.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Raise your Luck to the level required by the installed version and catch the Midas Fish through normal fishing. A chest or command item does not count.
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.6_2.title: Net Result
jem_guide.advancement.fishing.6_2.descri: Capture a Barracuda with a net and move it alive.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Use Spawn’s intended net on a living Barracuda. Complete the achievement when the creature is actually captured by the net system rather than killed for an item.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.root.title: So Who's the Boss?
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.root.descri: Some health bars clearly want to get acquainted.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Find the great threats of each dimension and bring them down.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1.title: Star of the Show
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1.descripti: Defeat the Wither and obtain a Nether Star; more than one boss gate will want it.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Summon and defeat the Wither normally. Recover its Nether Star; later boss systems use it as a genuine progression key.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_1_1_4.des: Defeat the Ancient Remnant in the Cursed Pyramid.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Reach the boss inside a real Cursed Pyramid and defeat the Ancient Remnant. The Pyramid's individual rooms and general structure discovery are not separate Bosses achievements.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_1_1_5.des: Defeat the Leviathan in the Sunken City.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Progress through the Sunken City to its primary boss and defeat the Leviathan. No rods, catches, or fishing progression are involved; this is purely the dungeon's boss completion.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_1_1_7.des: Defeat Maledictus in the Frosted Prison.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Reach the Frosted Prison's main encounter and defeat Maledictus.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_2_1.title: Architect Laid Off
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.1_2_1.descr: Defeat Netherman, the Architect of Chaos.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Defeat Netherman completely. Chaotic Essence then hands off to Arsenal for weapon ability progression.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.2_1.title: Yeti Another One
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.2_2.title: Well Done
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.3_2.title: That's a Wrap
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Land the killing blow on a Mummy yourself.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.3_7.title: Something Stalks the Dark
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.3_7.descrip: Defeat a Stalker from either installed Deep Dark expansion.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Kill a Deep Dark Regrowth Stalker yourself.
jem_guide.advancement.bosses.5_1.title: Extinction Event
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Finish the summoned volcanic encounter and defeat Luxtructosaurus. The post-boss Atlatitan world unlock belongs to Mobs, while Tectonic Shard and Extinction Spear usage belongs to Arsenal.
jem_guide.advancement.building.root.desc: Turn a pile of blocks into a place with character.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Turn a shelter into a place worth returning to.
jem_guide.advancement.building.1.title: Not Everything Needs to Be a Cube
jem_guide.advancement.building.1.descrip: Place your first real timber beam.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Craft and place a Woodworks Beam. The achievement is about the dedicated building beam, not a normal log.
jem_guide.advancement.building.14.title: Holidays Don't Decorate Themselves
jem_guide.advancement.building.14.descri: Make your first batch of holiday gems.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Combine Magenta Dye and an Emerald using the Holidays Gem recipe and obtain the first batch of nine Gems.
jem_guide.advancement.building.4.title: Now We Can Live Here
jem_guide.advancement.building.4.descrip: Place the first piece of furniture that makes a room feel lived in.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Place any modded furniture block: a table, chair, bench, couch, cabinet, nightstand, shelf, or another furnishing.
jem_guide.advancement.building.7.title: The House Has a Voice
jem_guide.advancement.building.7.descrip: Hang a working wind chime at your home.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Craft any Chime and hang it outside or beside the entrance of a build.
jem_guide.advancement.building.7_4.title: Glow and Chime
jem_guide.advancement.building.7_4.descr: Hang a chime that decorates the area and provides light.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Craft and hang an Amethyst Crystal Wind Chime. It must be placed in the world as part of a build, not merely carried in inventory.
jem_guide.advancement.building.8.title: Smoke Goes Up
jem_guide.advancement.building.8.descrip: Build a chimney that genuinely emits smoke.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Place a Chimney above a suitable smoke or fire source so smoke genuinely exits through the chimney.
jem.advancement.engineering.root.title: Engineering
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Begin with Create, then learn what hard work does to a drill.
jem.advancement.engineering.drill_work.d: Let a moving drilling machine cut through rock on its own.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Build a moving contraption with a Mechanical Drill and use it to bore through a normal natural rock block. The drill must break the block as part of the moving contraption.
Create Mechanical Drill contraption + JEM wear
jem.advancement.engineering.drill_servic: Stop the machine and service a worn drill with iron.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Fully stop the drilling machine and use an Iron Ingot to service a worn Mechanical Drill. One repaired drill must consume one Iron Ingot.
JEM Mechanical Drill repair + Iron Ingot
jem.advancement.engineering.drill_replac: Replace an exhausted drill and keep the same machine working.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Wear out a Mechanical Drill with no repairs remaining, replace it with a fresh Mechanical Drill, and resume drilling with the same machine.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.root.ti: What Else Is There to Do?
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.root.de: Not every good day has to move you closer to an ending.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Make music, take photographs, collect oddities, and enjoy the ride.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.cool_de: Kill a living entity with freezing caused by a snowball.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Kill a living entity with freezing damage built up by your snowballs. The snowball impact itself deals no damage.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.4_4.des: Make a new Photograph look like an old discovery.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Take a finished Photograph and turn it into an Aged Photograph using the current recipe that requires a Brush. Older recipes without the Brush do not apply to this version.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.play_a_: Play a live note on a musical instrument.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Play a live note on a musical instrument.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.zipline: Successfully attach to a cable with Zipline.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Successfully attach to a cable with Zipline.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.zipline: Release your grip while actively attached to a Zipline cable.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Release your grip while actively attached to a Zipline cable.
jem_guide.advancement.cool_stuff.zipline: Transfer directly from one valid Zipline cable to another.
jem_advancements.advancement_guide.entry: Transfer directly from one valid Zipline cable to another.
